comment: Hand corrections for the generated arm poses. The generator (make_poses.py)
renders each pose from the arm chain's own pixels and then applies these edits,
so a wrist pose or gripper shape can be fixed here without touching any code.
Coordinates are in the 96x96 canvas space (parts.json has the pivots).
Use pose "*" to edit every pose. Rebuild with: python source/make_poses.py
and then rebuild any clips: python source/render.py hello
The exported pose PNGs in source/pose_art/ can also be edited directly;
render.py reads those files, so a direct PNG edit takes effect on the next build.
